title: Online Individualized Treatment Selection under Partial Feedback: False Discovery Control and Minimax Optimality
abstract: arXiv:2610.16464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online individualized treatment selection when only the outcome under the assigned treatment is observed. Our objective is to preferentially treat individuals whose potential outcomes under treatment exceed a covariate-specific control reference, while limiting false discoveries among treated individuals. We propose Partial-Feedback Adaptive Individualized Treatment Selection (PAITS), which initializes learning from historical data and combines sequential estimation of local null risks, randomized exploration, and feedback-driven updates of the treatment selection threshold. Under regularity conditions, we establish asymptotic false discovery rate control and sublinear gap-weighted assignment regret relative to a population oracle. translated_title: 部分反馈下的在线个体化治疗选择：错误发现控制与极小极大最优性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在仅能观察到所分配治疗对应结果时的在线个体化治疗选择问题。我们的目标是在限制受治个体中错误发现数量的同时，优先治疗那些在治疗下的潜在结果超过特定协变量对照参考值的个体。我们提出了部分反馈自适应个体化治疗选择方法（PAITS），该方法从历史数据初始化学习，并结合了局部零假设风险的序贯估计、随机化探索以及由反馈驱动的治疗选择阈值更新。在正则性条件下，我们建立了渐近错误发现率控制，以及相对于总体预言机的次线性间隙加权分配遗憾。我们进一步在规定的均匀干扰估计要求下建立了分配遗憾的极小极大下界，并给出了PAITS达到相应约束极小极大最优性的条件。
tldr: 本文提出PAITS方法，在仅观察到所分配治疗结果的部分反馈场景下进行在线个体化治疗选择，同时实现了渐近错误发现率控制、相对于总体预言机的次线性分配遗憾，并达到了极小极大最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PAITS for online individualized treatment selection under partial feedback, achieving asymptotic false discovery rate control, sublinear gap-weighted assignment regret relative to a population oracle, and constrained minimax optimality.
